scope: Isolated internal Angular design system (src/app/marea-design-system) and its internal catalogue. Never applied to :root or to the public website.
knownLimitations: All colour, typography and layout values are internal proposals derived from MC-04; no value here is a public brand adoption.
Instrument day/sunlight/night modes are software-only specimens. No marine hardware visibility, daylight readability or night-vision performance is claimed: hardware validation remains BLOCKED.

The corporate web-light context keeps the measured MC-04 baseline values; it applies one proposed correction (focusRing) that is NOT applied to the live website, so MC-04 finding F-1 remains OPEN for the public site.
Contrast ratios are computed from declared token values only; they do not model anti-aliasing, glare, night adaptation or real display hardware.

web-light.label: Corporate web (light)
web-light.appliesTo: Isolated corporate web components on the existing light EMBARCARTE visual system. The live site itself is not restyled.

instrument-day.label: Instrument — day
instrument-day.appliesTo: Internal software specimens for bridge daylight use. Not a hardware readability claim.

instrument-sunlight.label: Instrument — sunlight
instrument-sunlight.appliesTo: Internal high-ambient-light software specimen. Glare readability is NOT validated; hardware validation is BLOCKED.

instrument-night.label: Instrument — night
instrument-night.appliesTo: Internal watchkeeping software specimen. Night-vision performance is NOT validated. No #000000 canvas and no #ffffff text.

canvas.semanticRole: Application background / page surface of the isolated component context.
canvas.evidence: MC-04 COLOUR-SYSTEM.md measured baseline; instrument roles from the proposed token contract.

surface.semanticRole: Panel that holds data; never a decorative card.

surfaceRaised.semanticRole: Grouped sub-surface; its boundary always carries a text label.

fieldSurface.evidence: Derived implementation layer: MC-04 defines no field token; the value keeps the existing site's input surface character.

line.semanticRole: Decorative divider rule only; never the sole boundary of an interactive control.

borderStrong.semanticRole: Interactive control boundary; meets the 3:1 non-text contrast requirement on its supported surfaces.
borderStrong.evidence: MC-04 non-text contrast requirement (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11); values measured in data/contrast-evidence.json.

textPrimary.evidence: MC-04 COLOUR-SYSTEM.md; instrument-day value from the proposed instrument block.

textSecondary.evidence: MC-04 COLOUR-SYSTEM.md; instrument values refined to meet the internal 5:1 target.

textMeta.evidence: MC-04 COLOUR-SYSTEM.md; instrument meta values refined for normal-size text.

textOnAccent.semanticRole: Text/icons placed on a filled action or state surface.

chartLine.semanticRole: Trend line / scale line required to understand content.

chartGrid.semanticRole: Grid, ticks and axis rules; supporting cue, never the only encoding.

action.semanticRole: Interactive text, links and filled action surfaces.

actionHover.semanticRole: Hover/active partner of the filled action surface.

actionQuietSurface.evidence: Derived implementation layer from the web-light --sky surface.

stateCritical.semanticRole: Alarm-level text/icon; always paired with shape, cause and required action.
stateCritical.evidence: MC-04 instrument token contract (tightened for cockpit reading).

stateCriticalSurface.evidence: Derived from the MC-04 badge background values; measured for 4.5:1 text contrast.

stateWarning.semanticRole: Caution/warning text/icon; always paired with a triangle and a label.

stateWarningSurface.evidence: Derived from the MC-04 badge background values; measured for 4.5:1 text contrast.

stateSafe.semanticRole: Normal/safe state text/icon; describes a signal, never a guarantee about the vessel.

stateSafeSurface.evidence: Derived from the MC-04 badge background values; measured for 4.5:1 text contrast.

stateStale.semanticRole: Stale/offline/no-data text/icon; always paired with an age counter and a pattern.

stateStaleSurface.evidence: Derived from the MC-04 badge background values; measured for 4.5:1 text contrast.

stateInfo.semanticRole: Advisory/info text/icon; neutral ink, not a hue accent.

focusRing.semanticRole: Keyboard focus indicator drawn on canvas/surface/raised.
focusRing.evidence: MC-04 proposes a compliant replacement (#0f5f8c) for the live site's #8fd2f5. Applied here only; the live site keeps #8fd2f5, so MC-04 finding F-1 remains OPEN for the public site.

focusRingOnFill.semanticRole: Focus indicator drawn inside a filled action/state control.

disabled.semanticRole: Disabled control text/icon; remains perceivable, never invisible.
disabled.evidence: MC-04 leaves the web-light disabled value unset; this implementation layer adds a measured internal value. WCAG 2.2 exempts disabled controls from text contrast, but the internal 3:1 floor is enforced as a quality target.

disabledSurface.evidence: Derived internal value, measured for a perceivable disabled boundary.

internalBannerSurface.semanticRole: Background of the mandatory internal/provisional status banner.
internalBannerSurface.evidence: Derived; required so every specimen displaying proposed MAREA identity carries a visible internal status.

internalBannerText.semanticRole: Text on the internal/provisional status banner.

display.semanticRole: Headings, display, product-family lockups and instrument numerics.
display.evidence: TYPOGRAPHY-SYSTEM.md measured tabular figures; @fontsource-variable/manrope 5.3.0 already installed.

body.semanticRole: Body text, labels, instructions and prose.
body.evidence: TYPOGRAPHY-SYSTEM.md; DM Sans is not numeric-capable for instrument figures.

display1.purpose: Page display statement on corporate surfaces.

heading.purpose: Component heading inside a panel or card.

controlSm.semanticRole: Compact control height; still above the 24px AA floor.

controlLg.semanticRole: Preferred wet/glove control height (internal design goal, not a WCAG minimum).

wetTargetPreferred.semanticRole: Internal preference for wet/glove use; NOT the AA minimum.

tileMin.semanticRole: Minimum instrument tile width; tiles wrap instead of shrinking text.

columns.semanticRole: Reference grid columns (documented; components use fluid minmax grids).

pill.semanticRole: Status chips with text only; never a decorative pill elsewhere.

none.semanticRole: Default: flat surfaces, no decorative shadow.

overlay.semanticRole: Overlays only (navigation panel, explanatory panel). Never used for cards.

decorative.semanticRole: Decorative only; never applied to essential text or status.

mutedIcon.semanticRole: Non-essential icon softening; text never softened.

offset.semanticRole: Focus outline offset on flat surfaces.

inset.semanticRole: Inset focus ring inside filled controls.

easeStandard.semanticRole: Calm standard easing; no bounce, no spring.

alertMaxHz.semanticRole: Maximum optional alert pulse rate; reduced-motion disables it.

bp320.semanticRole: Minimum supported viewport; reflow test floor.

sticky.semanticRole: Sticky section chrome inside the catalogue.

dataStatusSemantics.note: Cause and required action accompany the alarm; acknowledgement never removes the condition.
Cause and required action accompany the warning.
Describes a received signal, never a guarantee about the vessel.
Age counter always rendered; no frozen last value.
Neutral advisory ink, not a hue accent.

forbiddenValues.note: Night mode must not use a pure black canvas or pure white text (MC-04 halation rule §5.8). Values are checked against resolved colours, not source strings.
